decision_policy.summary: Record the unresolved check, or ready if all six checks pass. At most one check is unresolved in any scenario, so no priority order is needed.
design_rationale: The variables are directly traceable to NMAH borrower and agreement requirements.
The object scope excludes materials needing tighter object-specific limits.

Scenarios contain at most one unresolved check (generation_plan.invalid_configurations excludes every pair of unresolved states), so each non-ready outcome names that check and the rules are mutually exclusive; rule order is presentational.
Real loan reviews often find several open items at once; restricting to one is a benchmark scoping choice that removes any dependence on a priority order.

rules.explanation: Continuous physical or electronic security is required.
The chosen general-object scope uses NMAH’s stated environmental range.
The documented general ceiling is 20 footcandles.
New materials must off-gas for at least 28 days.
All-risk wall-to-wall coverage must be arranged.
All six scoped shipment-readiness checks pass.
